Banked because the floor was left one above what the branch measures, which fails exact mode in the improvement direction and was red for every session until somebody wrote it down.

Identified rather than guessed: the gate's output diffed by FILE AND NAME between 3b47395ce1ab, this floor's previous stamp, and the banked commit -- exactly one entry GONE, `odoo/addons/base/models/res_partner.py _compute_duplicate_ids`, and nothing NEW. Line numbers stripped first, because this gate reports one entry per distinct NAME and re-points at another declarer when the first one goes, so a diff that keeps positions manufactures pairs.

Measured on a pristine detached worktree, `git status --porcelain` empty there, and the branch tip re-read before the transfer.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains, and because `ratchet.py --update` REPLACES this field rather than appending to it:

FOUR NAMES, FOUR UNITS -- and that is not the usual case. 245 -> 241 for the four domain builders renamed head-first in 3b47395ce1ab (_get_domain_<what>, per the gate own message). The gate counts distinct NAMES with setdefault, not definitions, so the first file the walk reaches wins and later declarers of the same name are invisible: two of these four are declared more than once (_get_outgoing_domain in stock and stock_dropshipping, _get_moves_to_assign_domain in stock, mrp and mrp_subcontracting) and renaming stock alone would have moved this number by ZERO while re-pointing the report at modules the commit never touched. Every declarer moved, so every name went away, so the count moved by exactly four. The converse is odoo-54 own bank one commit earlier at 249 -> 245: FIVE renames, four units, because _lang_get is declared in six modules and fixing one is worth nothing here. Read this number as names retired, never as renames made. The findings themselves are not new -- 447123cb3e10 widened _returns_domain, which had wanted a non-empty list literal as positive evidence and so could not see a method returning only Domain([...]), the spelling this fork prefers.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Five field hooks in addons/mail renamed for the row 2.4.1 gives them: _open_activity_domain, _next_activity_domain and _get_module_xmlid_domain to _get_domain_*, mail.guest._lang_get to _selection_langs, and _get_rotting_domain to _get_domain_rotting_records across all seven of its declarers (mail, crm, project, hr_recruitment, test_mail and enterprise/helpdesk).

FIVE RENAMES, FOUR UNITS, and the shortfall is the gate rather than a miscount. measure() keys both of its tables on the method NAME with setdefault -- selection_methods.setdefault(method, ...) and domain_methods.setdefault(item.name, ...) -- so the count is per distinct name, not per definition, and the file it cites is whichever the walk reached first. _get_rotting_domain is worth a unit because every declarer moved and the name left the tree. mail.guest._lang_get is worth none, because payment, hr, event, survey and base still declare that name; the rename is right and invisible to a per-name count. A floor that moves by less than the work is the expected reading for this gate.

The same dedup makes its report re-point at modules nobody touched: removing the first declarer of a shared name promotes another file into the listing, so a naive before/after diff showed six entries "appearing" in fleet, l10n_bg_ledger, payment, pos_restaurant, pos_self_order and product, none of them new. Diff this gate by NAME ONLY.

Measured 245 on a pristine detached worktree, git status --porcelain empty there first, and confirmed identical at the branch tip so the floor is not banked below what the tip reads. Peer drift ruled out rather than assumed: pristine worktrees at 661a7a0d891 (the previous stamp) and at the pre-commit tip both read 249 on committed content, so the whole -4 is this change. Banked apart from the renames on 5e3c2f70d05's precedent. odoo-3a is moving this same floor with a stock sweep in the same window and had not banked when this landed; they re-measure rather than subtract from it.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

field_hook_naming._returns_domain could not see a domain built the way this fork builds them. It required at least one return to be a NON-EMPTY LIST literal as positive evidence -- a guard that is right and stays: is_domain accepts a bare [], and an empty list is also every other empty list in the tree, so it cannot be the evidence that a method builds a domain. But a Domain(...) call is positive evidence too and was not counted, so a method returning only Domain([...]) satisfied all(is_domain), failed the list-literal clause, and was reported by nothing. The guard was written when a domain was a list and never revisited. Widening it to accept either shape is the whole of the +24: 29 new findings, of which 6 were in odoo/odoo/addons/base and are fixed in 661a7a0d891 (ir_attachment_assets _generated_asset_domain and its esm sibling, ir_ui_view _get_default_view_domain and _get_template_domain, res_users _get_login_domain and _get_email_domain -> the _get_domain_<what> form), leaving 23; the remaining +1 is one name whose reported FILE moved because the gate dedupes by name and one of two definitions sharing a spelling was renamed. Decomposed by kind rather than asserted: misnamed 102 -> 102 unchanged, unmarked 38 -> 62. The 23 are §2.4.1 backlog and not new defects -- that section prescribes _get_domain_<what> for a free-standing domain and records that "an earlier rule asked only for a _domain suffix", which is exactly what they wear (_get_tax_exigible_domain, _get_rotting_domain, _get_recipients_domain and 20 more across account, stock, mail, portal, website and 8 other addons). Parent d553c7c19778 measures 225 and this commit 249, each in its own detached worktree with nothing copied in, because the shared checkout is carrying another session's work.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

field_hook_naming.py gained a selection= branch, closing the gap §2.4.2 records as "enforced by nothing": selection= is a sixth field-declaration keyword ATTRS stops short of, and the Selection row asserts the OPPOSITE of every other rule in the file -- a selection hook is named for its VALUES, so one method serves fields of several names (_selection_target_model is pointed at by resource_ref, parent_ref and preview_record_ref). Through ATTRS the rule would have demanded a rename of exactly those three, so selection is a scope of its own whose whole assertion is the _selection_ prefix, and it resolves the forwarding lambda as well as the string because §2.4.2 says the lambda is where the binding stops being visible. 206 -> 225 is three movements and only two are this change. (1) The parent commit 7e36f8314f5 already measures 205, not 206, and the -1 is UNATTRIBUTED: odoo-29 measured this gate at 8e705b6ea44~1, 8e705b6ea44, 13a873d2a07, 689d0843e1d9, 042da509ff6 and 0b36645d63c, one detached checkout each, and every one reads 205 -- so none of that day's vocabulary commits moved it. The drop is somewhere in the 1418 commits between this floor's previous stamp 8f4a84e8151 and 8e705b6ea44~1; the 30 oldest of that range read 206. (2) The new branch adds 22, of which 20 are under addons/ and 2 under odoo/odoo/addons/base. (3) Both of those 2 are fixed in the same commit -- ir.model.fields _field_types -> _selection_field_types and res.lang _get_date_format_selection -> _selection_date_formats, each a module-level function passed by REFERENCE rather than by name, which is why no scan resolving only selection="_x" had ever read either, and why §2.4.2's frozen figure is the smaller half of the residue. That leaves 20 as debt: 8 are l10n, and the commonest spelling is the read verb (_get_year_selection, _get_task_states) or no verb at all (_l10n_bg_document_type_selection_values). Measured at 35a01c2a87f in a detached worktree, parent measured at 7e36f8314f5 the same way, because the shared checkout was carrying five sessions' uncommitted work. General finding worth more than this number: ratchet.py --list resolves a stamp and never re-measures a count, so an un-orphaned floor can be silently stale in the LOWERING direction indefinitely -- nothing routine runs this gate, and nobody has checked the other 80.
